data.name: Crew Up
data.detailed_description:
Crew Up is a multiplayer first-person game where players take the roles of crew members inside a combat vehicle, whether it is a tank, APC, IFV, or other military vehicle, performing their own tasks inside the machine. A player can take up to 4 different positions inside a tank, such as driver, gunner, loader, or commander.

The game features engaging mechanics that create the feeling of real tank control. Players can look through vision blocks, control the tank turret, the commander can independently turn the turret toward a target, and the loader has an interesting interactive loading mechanic.

The Commander is the most important member of the crew and leads the tank into battle. The commander monitors the battlefield situation and gives orders to the other crew members.

The Gunner controls the vehicle’s firepower. They operate the turret and fire both the main gun and secondary weapons, if available.

The Loader ensures fast reloading of the tank’s main gun. Reloading speed depends on the personal skill of the player occupying this position, as well as several other factors.

The Driver controls the tank. The tank’s positioning and movement speed depend on them.

Features

  • Carefully recreated vehicle control mechanics

  • Everything depends on teamwork and the crew’s ability to communicate

  • Detailed damage system for the tank and its modules

data.short_description: Crew Up is a first-person game where combat vehicles are operated by the combined efforts of their crew. Each player takes a specific seat in the tank and performs a combat role, such as driver, gunner, loader, or commander. Join tank battles and see what a tanker’s life really looks like!

content_descriptors.notes: contains images of blood and violence
